verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project, and the docs state you can commit those files to share the setup with your team. A hands-on dry run confirmed it targets both `.agents/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/ultrametric/SKILL.md`, so committing them distributes the skill to Codex and Claude Code users. Missing for 10: no marketplace or plugin-registry distribution path, no evidence of bundling a custom or multi-skill team set beyond the single Ultrametric skill, no hands-on confirmation of the non-dry-run write or of a teammate picking up committed files. [2026-10-08 adversarial bias audit (owner-product bring-up lane): reverted full 7 -> partial 5 — parity: gstack's dedicated team tooling (./setup --team + gstack-team-init) and superpowers' shared marketplace repo both sit at partial 5; the owner product's only path is committing two generated SKILL.md files for a single skill, with no team tooling and no hands-on teammate pickup. The owner product does not get the higher reading of an ambiguous bar. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
